statement: Acquisition manifest for the link-only sources. kb-fetch downloads automatic entries with a plain client and checks each sha256; manual entries are hosts that refused a scripted client or files not yet obtained, and kb-fetch prints the browser step for them. A host can refuse later even where it worked before, so complete automatic retrieval is not promised. Nothing listed here is republished in this repository.
